defaults.video_script: At the twenty twenty two World Cup, Lionel Messi found the net in every single round. He scored in the group stage, the round of sixteen, the quarter final, the semi final, and the final. Seven goals in total, including two against France in the final. Argentina won on penalties, and Messi was named the best player of the entire tournament.
